name: MUSES8921 / MUSES8921AN
tagline: Nisshinbo's Oct 2025 'standard' JFET MUSES: MUSES8920/A reworked with flagship tuning methods; 5 pA bias for DAC I/V.

lineage.note: Made predecessor MUSES8920 (separate part number); English datasheet Ver.10 mirrored at Mouser and DigiKey.
MUSES8920A replaced MUSES8920 with unchanged specs, circuit and sound; still sold as MUSES8920AE.
Originator and sole source of MUSES8921, the 'standard model' of the J-FET MUSES line.

part_numbers.note: Released 2025-10-09. Sample price ¥500 at 1,000 units. Native DIP8 reported once, unconfirmed.
EMP-8-AN (SOP8-class, 3.9×5.0×1.65 mm). ANAE2S is the DigiKey orderable code.
DFN4035-8-GR (4.0×3.5×0.75 mm), listed in the English datasheet.
Kyoritsu Products module, not Nisshinbo: AN on gold-pin DIP-8 board. Digit stock 2026-01-19.

key_specs.value: ±3.5 V to ±17 V (abs. max ±18 V, reportedly)
J-FET input; EMP8 confirmed, DIP8 unconfirmed

reputation.summary: Too new (October 2025) for a consensus. Praise is mostly Nisshinbo's own claim, repeated by trade press: flagship tuning applied to MUSES8920/A via signal/power-path review and element placement. Blogger new_western_elec compared it with NL8902 and posted a listening test (Apr 2026), framing 8920 → 8920A → 8921 as step-wise upgrades. Headline specs equal MUSES8920A's. No independent measurements.
typical_uses: Preamps, line amps and active filters
Op-amp rolling via Kyoritsu MUSES8921AN-DIP module
caveats: Separate part number from MUSES8920/8920A; do not assume the same die.
Typical specs (8.0 nV/√Hz, 0.0004%, 25 V/µs, 11 MHz, 5 pA, ±3.5–±17 V) match MUSES8920A; benefits unmeasured; no ASR/Groner data.
Retail 'DIP' units are SMD MUSES8921AN on an adapter board; check height and socket fit.
Costs more than MUSES8920AE (about ¥1,700 vs ¥1,200 in Japan; the 8921 price probably includes the adapter).
MUSES line supply uncertain: MUSES05/03 reportedly dropped (2024-06), blogger concern after Dec 2025 Nisshinbo HD news.

counterfeit_notes: No MUSES8921 fakes reported yet. MUSES01/02 fakes are reportedly common on Chinese marketplaces (genuine laser-marked, fakes ink-printed). Buy from Akizuki, Kyoritsu, Mouser or DigiKey. Distrust any native-DIP8 'MUSES8921D'; relabelled MUSES8920/A is a plausible risk.

Is there a native DIP8 (e.g. 'D' suffix) orderable version?

claims_confirmed: Nisshinbo announced the MUSES8921 series on 2025-10-09 (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/about/info/20251009.html).
Akizuki's Japanese datasheet copy is Ver.1.0 (https://akizukidenshi.com/goodsaffix/MUSES8921_J.pdf).
Topas hosts an English datasheet copy, MUSES8921_E.pdf (https://www.topas.de/fileadmin/Dateien/NIS/MUSES8921_E.pdf).
8.0 nV/√Hz and 0.0004% THD at 1 kHz, 25 V/µs, 5 pA bias (https://www.electronics-lab.com/nisshinbo-launches-dual-audio-operational-amplifier-for-high-quality-sound-and-audio-applications/).
11 MHz GBW, ±3.5 to ±17 V, EMP8-to-DIP module for MUSES8921AN (https://eleshop.jp/shop/g/gQ1U411/).
Kyoritsu Products sells MUSES8921AN as the MUSES8921AN-DIP module (https://www.yodobashi.com/product/100000001009795066/).
Based on MUSES8920/A with signal/power path review and element-placement optimisation (https://av.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/2054127.html).
new_western_elec posted a MUSES8921 listening test in Apr 2026 (https://nw-electric.way-nifty.com/blog/2026/04/post-f925c9.html).
Mouser hosts the English MUSES8920 datasheet Ver.10 (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/MUSES8920_E-259012.pdf).
refuted_claims: Supply range is not unconfirmed: it is ±3.5 to ±17 V operating (absolute maximum ±18 V, reportedly).
The 'AN' suffix is real: MUSES8921AN is the EMP8 part name in Kyoritsu Products module listings.
corrections: Added MUSES8921AN (EMP8) and the Kyoritsu MUSES8921AN-DIP module; Japanese 'DIP8' retail units are probably this module.
